.memory/assumptions/ASSUME-0002-external.title: User authentication delegates to external OIDC provider
.memory/assumptions/ASSUME-0002-external.content_snippet: The digital service delegates user authentication to an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider rather than managing internal username and password stores. Delegating authentication to a standards-compliant identity provider improves security posture and complies with enterprise identity standards.
